name: Stage 48: Svärta kyrka to Holmsjön
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 48, Svärta kyrka to Holmsjön.
utilities: Svärta/Svärta kyrka has the practical start services: bus stops near the stage junction and church, simple church-area parking, an access-dependent church toilet, and a seasonal summer tap.

Masugnsjön is the main on-stage overnight/rest node, with an official shelter, fireplace, and dry toilet on the lakeside rock slab. It is shared/first-come and should not be treated as stocked: no guaranteed firewood and no trash service.

Holmsjön endpoint has no confirmed parking, toilet, shop, or direct transit. Plan pickup carefully or continue to stage 49; the nearest researched bus options are back toward Borrvinds kvarn/Åbro vägskäl or onward toward Tystberga.
No reliable active food, lodging, or resupply was found on stage 48 itself. Older Åstugan cafe references are closed/outdated; Tystberga services are next-stage and over 2 km away.
waterSources: The only verified drinking-water refill is the seasonal summer tap at Svärta kyrka, about 20 m left of the church gate; verify season and current availability.
Masugnsjön and Holmsjön are natural surface-water options only. Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality, so filter/boil/treat if used and carry enough water from Svärta.

No mid-stage public tap, shop, or all-season drinking-water point was found. Team Vildmark-style multi-stage planning notes reinforce carrying enough water or a filter if continuing beyond the start tap.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 8 km; Naturkartan measures 7.8 km/7,779 m and the local drawn geometry is about 7.81 km with endpoints close to official coordinates. OSM relation metadata may still show 9 km; treat that as stale legacy tagging, not a reroute.

Topology is clean when OSM relation 7449355 is assembled by shared endpoints rather than raw member order: OSM measures about 7.814 km, starts within 2 m of official 58.817583,17.078333, and ends at 58.829213,17.165855, about 22 m from the official Stage 49/Holmsjön start cluster.
Main-route stage from Svärta kyrka/stage 47 to Holmsjön/stage 49. Expect mixed road, forest road, and hillier forest path, with several road sections before the Masugnsjön/Holmsjön finish.

The stage is unusually strong on mining and ironworks history: Svärta gård/Norshammars bruk, Borrvinds kvarn, Ullabergs masugn, a possible side trip to Förola gruva, and older smelting remains by Masugnsjön.

Hiker/blog reports describe quite a lot of road walking, old E4/Riksettan/E4 noise, and some forestry/clearcut/open sections, but the Masugnsjön shore and shelter area as the scenic high point. A local walking report notes that the old A1/Svärtaån corridor can be narrow and wet, which explains why some road walking is structural rather than a temporary detour.

Terrain is not technically hard but has concentrated rolling/hillier parts and a steeper leafy Svärta-side climb. After rain, wet leaves and ordinary lowland dampness can make slopes and forest-machine/forestry sections less tidy.

No current official fault reports or closure notices were found on 2026-04-27 for Svärta, Masugnsjön, the E4 wildlife tunnel, or Holmsjön. Ostlänken/E4 works around Holmsjön are a future monitoring item, not a current route change. Fire status is dynamic; check Nyköping/Sörmlandskustens current fire-ban page before using the Masugnsjön fireplace.

Holmsjön is a weak logistics endpoint: no parking or close public transport was verified at the stage end. Plan pickup carefully, backtrack to road-corridor stops, or continue toward Tystberga on stage 49.

facilities.name: Svärta stage junction
facilities.description: Official stage 48 start and stage 47 end along road 223 near Svärta kyrka.

facilities.name: Svärta bus stop
facilities.description: Closest start-side Sörmlandstrafiken stop by the stage junction. Older route references mention 555/655; current service may be mainly 655/656 or school-day patterns, so verify live departures.

facilities.name: Svärta kyrka bus stop
facilities.description: Alternative church-side stop about 0.5 km from the start and near the water/church area; verify current service.

facilities.name: Svärta kyrka
facilities.description: Medieval church with 1200s origins; Sörmlandsleden notes the first Swedish confirmation was held here in 1736 by Jakob Serenius.

facilities.name: Svärta kyrka summer tap
facilities.description: Official summer tap about 20 m left of the church gate; seasonal and should be verified before relying on it.

facilities.name: Svärta kyrka toilet
facilities.description: OSM-mapped toilet at/near the church; not listed by Sörmlandsleden for this stage, so treat as locally verified/access-dependent rather than guaranteed 24/7.

facilities.name: Svärta kyrka parking
facilities.description: Simple church-area parking roughly 350 m from the stage start per official/Naturkartan notes. Verify signs and event restrictions.

facilities.name: Svärta gård / Norshammars bruk context
facilities.description: Historic ironworks landscape near the old E4 corridor. The main building is private/not a public trail facility.

facilities.name: Åstugan cafe closed/outdated listing
facilities.description: Older maps/blogs may mention Åstugan cafe near the Svärtaån/old-road corridor, but current cafe listings mark it closed. Do not rely on food or toilet service here.

facilities.name: Svärtaån / old A1 road-walk caution
facilities.description: Road-walk and narrow/wet-edge caution. A local walking report notes the Svärtaån corridor was too narrow and waterlogged for the trail to fit beside the road in places.

facilities.name: Åbro vägskäl bus access
facilities.description: Road-corridor bus stop near the early/mid-stage heritage corridor. Useful bailout/access context; verify live departures.

facilities.name: Borrvinds kvarn bus stop
facilities.description: Mapped bus stop on the road corridor near the Borrvinds kvarn context; also one of the closest transit options to the Holmsjön end, but still not close.

facilities.name: Borrvinds kvarn opposite bus stop
facilities.description: Opposite-side Borrvinds kvarn stop on the same road corridor. Useful bailout context only if live service matches the trip.

facilities.name: Borrvinds kvarn / Hedvigsfors context
facilities.description: Heritage context near where cannon blanks from the local blast furnaces were bored using water power; no public service verified.

facilities.name: Ullabergs masugn
facilities.description: Visible blast-furnace remains with dams and information on site; good rest/interpretive stop. Historic sources date the furnace to 1761 and use into the 1800s.

facilities.name: Förola gruva side-trip context
facilities.description: Optional mining-history detour from the official route area. Coordinate is approximate and visitor-safe access should be verified; do not treat mine remains as a facility.

facilities.name: Masugnsskogen nature reserve side trip
facilities.description: Off-route reserve about 1 km north of the trail with difficult unmarked old forest and fallen trees; show as side-trip context, not as an on-stage facility.

facilities.name: Masugnsskogen reserve rules
facilities.description: Off-route reserve rules prohibit camping and fires; dead and fallen trees are protected habitat and should be left in place. Länsstyrelsen also notes bark-beetle-damaged trees, so watch for falling-tree risk.

facilities.name: Masugnsjön forest-road climb
facilities.description: After Ullabergs masugn the route follows forest road and more uneven/hillier forest terrain toward Masugnsjön. Expect possible forestry/open clearcut feel rather than continuous old forest.

facilities.name: Masugnsjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter after about 7 km, on a larger rock slab with views over Masugnsjön. Shared, first-come shelter; no booking, no trash bins, and do not assume firewood.

facilities.name: Masugnsjön shelter fireplace
facilities.description: Official text confirms a good fireplace at the Masugnsjön shelter. Use only when current fire-ban and local fire-risk rules allow; Sörmlandsleden does not supply firewood and nearby reserve dead wood must not be collected.

facilities.name: Masugnsjön dry toilet
facilities.description: OSM and official text confirm a toilet at/near the Masugnsjön shelter area.

facilities.name: Masugnsjön lake water
facilities.description: Lake water only, not a verified potable source. Filter/boil/treat if used; shoreline access may be awkward/steep and washing or toilet needs should stay well away from the shore.

facilities.name: Wildlife tunnel under E4
facilities.description: The final approach passes through a wildlife/hiker tunnel under the motorway before reaching Holmsjön. Do not attempt to cross E4 at grade; expect traffic noise and keep to the marked route.

facilities.name: Holmsjön stage junction
facilities.description: Official stage 49 start and stage 48 end at Holmsjön's northwest tip. No parking is confirmed at this endpoint.

facilities.name: Holmsjön OSM chain snap
facilities.description: OSM relation 7449355 ends here and Stage 49 begins here exactly; this is about 22 m from the official/Naturkartan Holmsjön start cluster. Merge these for route-builder continuity.

facilities.name: Holmsjön lake water
facilities.description: Natural lake water at the endpoint only; not a tested drinking-water source. Treat/filter/boil if used.

facilities.name: Holmsjön access caveat
facilities.description: No parking is listed at the Holmsjön stage start/end and no close transit stop was verified. Arrange pickup, walk back to road-corridor stops, or continue toward Tystberga on stage 49.

facilities.name: Stage 48 OSM distance caveat
facilities.description: Official/Naturkartan/local geometry agree on about 7.8-8 km. OSM relation metadata may still show 9 km and should be treated as stale tagging.

facilities.name: Holmsjön / Ostlänken future works watch
facilities.description: Trafikverket Ostlänken/E4 planning includes future work around Holmsjön and a friluftspassage near the existing E4 passage. No current route closure was found on 2026-04-27; recheck when construction changes.

facilities.name: Tystberga trafikplats bus access
facilities.description: Off-route transit context for onward planning from Holmsjön/stage 49, not a stage-48 endpoint stop. Mark as distant/off-route if shown.

facilities.name: Stage 48 fire-risk check
facilities.description: The Masugnsjön fireplace is the only verified fire point on stage 48. No formal fire ban was found on 2026-04-27, but status changes quickly; check Nyköping/Sörmlandskustens current fire-ban status before use.
